items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: But another guy, Happy Johnson, a trombone player. We both picked bones the same day.

ctx.x: Yes, he's older than I am. But another guy, Happy Johnson, a trombone player. We both picked bones the same day. He only lived about two blocks from my house in Little Rock. He got to be a pretty good name.
HE DID PRETTY WELL OUT IN CALIFORNIA.
